data.description:
## Symptom (observed 2026-08-22 ~19:35-19:50 UTC, main checkout + worktrees at ~af3ea35617f)

Under heavy multi-session load (~20 concurrent rebar CLI processes across worktrees sharing
the one tracker), `rebar show airborne-wellloved-kingfisher` (epic 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a,
23 children) produced ZERO output for >200 s across two attempts (killed at 75 s and 211 s).
Meanwhile, in the same window, on the same store:

- `rebar list --parent 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a` — a strictly LARGER payload (778.6 KB, all 23
  children serialized) — completed in ~67 s.
- Other rebar writes (comment/edit/link/claim) completed in 3-30 s.
- EVERY rebar invocation logs `WARNING rebar.llm.enrich_drain: enrich drain gate check took
  N ms (> 20 ms budget)` with N observed 339-3589 ms (17-180x budget).

## Why this looks like a defect, not just load

The asymmetry is the signal: `show` (one ticket + children summaries) stalls indefinitely
while `list --parent` (full serialization of the same subtree) completes. That suggests
`show` takes a path with per-child store reads, lock acquisition, or enrich-drain gate checks
that serialize/contend quadratically, rather than the bulk read `list` uses. The enrich-drain
overruns being universal suggests the gate check itself does store reads under contention.

## Repro guidance (load-dependent; account for non-determinism)

Needs concurrent-writer pressure: run N>=10 parallel rebar processes (mix of comment/edit/
transition) against one store while timing `rebar show <epic-with-20+-children>` vs
`rebar list --parent <same>`. Quantify the stall rate; a single fast run does not reject.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Root cause confirmed via /rebar-debug (mechanism named at file:line, discriminating
      experiment run, caused_by attributed).
- [ ] `rebar show <epic>` completes within the same order of magnitude as
      `rebar list --parent <epic>` under the repro's concurrent load.
- [ ] The enrich-drain gate-check overrun is either fixed or its budget/warning recalibrated
      with a recorded rationale (no silent 180x-over-budget steady state).
data.title: rebar show stalls indefinitely on an epic under concurrent store load while list --parent completes
